question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"parents."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires a noun that can complete the sentence.
 
• The options given are self, friends, relatives, and parents.
 
• Out of these, only** parents** can logically fit in the sentence.
 
• **"Parent" **means a person’s mother or father. (माता या पिता)
 
 
• **Example**: *I love my **parents**__.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, option 4 is the correct answer.
 
• Correct passage:

In a busy bus station, there is a little girl sitting all __alone__ on a bench. She stares at the floor as all the busy travellers rush __around__ her. Some of the people are in such a big hurry that they do not __notice__ her. Other people look at her, but continue running to where they need to go. After some time, a man stops next to the girl. He is very tired after a long day of work, and he just wants to get to his home as quickly as __possible__ so that he can be with his family. But he cannot just leave this little girl alone. He cannot see her __**parents**__ anywhere. The little girl is no older than his own little daughter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Self: **a person’s own nature or qualities. (व्‍यक्ति का अपना स्‍वभाव या अपने गुण)
 
• **Friends: **a person that you know and like (not a member of your family), and who likes you. (मित्र, दोस्‍त (जो परिवार का सदस्‍य नहीं है))
 
• **Relatives: **a member of your family. ((आपके) परिवार का सदस्‍य, नातेदार, रिश्‍तेदार, संबंधी व्‍यक्ति)
